steps.title: From the external point ,

\]

steps.title: For the lower secant,

\]

steps.body:

PB\times PA=PC\times PD

\]

steps.title: so triangle is isosceles and

\]

steps.title: Let the radius of the
steps.body: Let the radius of the smaller sphere be \(r\).

steps.title: Let the radius of the
steps.body: Let the radius of the larger sphere be \(R\).

steps.title: Surface area of a sphere
steps.body:
Surface area of a sphere is

\[
4\pi r^2
\]

steps.title: The surface area of sphere
steps.body:
The surface area of sphere \(A\) is nine times the surface area of sphere \(B\), so

\[
4\pi R^2=9(4\pi r^2)
\]

\[
R^2=9r^2
\]

\[
R=3r
\]

steps.title: The difference between the volumes
steps.body:
The difference between the volumes is \(117\pi\):

\[
\frac{4}{3}\pi(3r)^3-\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3=117\pi
\]

\[
\frac{4}{3}\pi(27r^3-r^3)=117\pi
\]

\[
\frac{104}{3}\pi r^3=117\pi
\]

steps.title: For part (a), is the
steps.body:
For part (a), \(BE\) is the space diagonal using the three perpendicular lengths:

\[
AB=15,\qquad BC=4,\qquad CF=9
\]

\[
BE^2=15^2+4^2+9^2
\]

\[
BE^2=225+16+81=322
\]

\[
BE=\sqrt{322}=17.9\text{ cm}
\]

steps.title: For part (b), the projection
steps.body:
For part (b), the projection of \(PU\) onto the plane \(PQRS\) is \(PR\).

\[
PR=42
\]

steps.title: The angle between and the
steps.body:
The angle between \(PU\) and the plane is \(30^\circ\), so

\[
\tan 30^\circ=\frac{RU}{PR}
\]

\[
RU=42\tan30^\circ
\]

steps.title: Since is the midpoint of
steps.body:
Since \(M\) is the midpoint of \(PR\),

\[
MR=21
\]

steps.title: In right triangle ,
steps.body:
In right triangle \(MRU\),

\[
\tan \angle UMR=\frac{RU}{MR}
\]

\[
\tan \angle UMR=\frac{42\tan30^\circ}{21}
\]

\[
\tan \angle UMR=2\tan30^\circ
\]

\[
\angle UMR=49.1^\circ
\]
